body:
Your ask: a horse riding instructor at the farm's horse obstacle course (Horse jump field). Same people style as the farmers. All wear a whistle and riding boots.
- Coach Greta: black riding helmet, red riding jacket, white breeches, riding crop
- Coach Marius: navy helmet and polo, beige breeches, clipboard
- Coach Ieva: lilac helmet, green vest, ponytail, hands free (crop removed, your note)
- Old coach Stan: flat cap, tweed vest, clipboard
You kept Ieva and Stan. Ieva changed, so please keep her once more in Model Compare: Farm riding → Riding instructor.

comments.text: Viewer: 3 passes + final: Greta 8, Marius 7, Ieva 7, Stan 7.
Ieva without the riding crop (your note). Checked: her hands are empty.
Approved: you decided it in Model Compare (31 Oct).
